channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: AI Clothing Swap
item.description: Upload a photo of yourself plus a garment and AI swaps the outfit onto you in seconds, keeping your pose and face — free preview, no sign-up.

item.title: Flowmaps: The Logic Layer for Agents and Developers
item.description: Maps every flow in your codebase into plain-language steps that stay in sync with the code, so developers and AI agents work from the same understanding of the system.

item.title: Wall Art Toolkit
item.description: A toolbox for Etsy wall-art sellers: print sizes, 300 PPI, pricing, tags and mockups, all in the browser.

item.title: LoanEssy
item.description: 75 free US loan calculators for car loans, mortgages, student debt and credit-card payoff — no sign-up needed.

item.title: Stacktrace
item.description: Real-time steering and guardrails that keep AI agents on track before they go off course.

item.title: KeywordTrail: Free Keyword Suggestion Tool
item.description: Type a seed word and collect Google Autocomplete suggestions, questions and preposition phrases across 52 languages and 249 countries, then filter and export as CSV.

item.title: Voidwear
item.description: Upload a clothing photo and AI turns it into a clean, store-ready product image in about a minute — no studio setup or Photoshop skills needed.

item.title: Curio: A Design Style Library for AI
item.description: Pick a design style, hand its DESIGN.md to your AI agent, and your site, deck or report gets dressed in seconds.

item.title: Folio: Notes That Live in Your Google Drive, Editable by Your AI
item.description: A free notes app that saves every note as a text file in your own Google Drive, and lets ChatGPT, Claude or Codex read and edit your notes on request.

item.title: SoundEtch: open source podcast/media editor for the browser
item.description: An open source podcast and media editor that runs entirely in the browser — open it and start cutting, no install needed.

item.title: AI Face Shape Detection and Custom Beard Design
item.description: Upload a selfie and let AI detect your face shape locally in the browser, then generate the beard style that fits it best — the shape test and style match are free.

item.title: HomeCanvas AI
item.description: Tell it your rooms and area and it draws a floor plan whose dimensions add up and where every room has a door — then keep editing or export it to CAD.

item.title: Poundsum
item.description: 52 free UK calculators for pay, tax, mortgages and pensions, using the latest GOV.UK figures and running entirely in your browser.

item.title: Block Blast Solver
item.description: Screenshot your Block Blast board and it reads the grid in your browser, then works out the best placement order for all three pieces with a step-by-step plan.

item.title: Hyperblog
item.description: An AI workbench for blogging that automates technical SEO, AI-search files and lead capture, live in five minutes.

item.title: Simplify Radicals Calculator
item.description: Enter a square or cube root and it simplifies it to exact radical form, with steps — handy for homework and checking answers.

item.title: Plane Deals
item.description: Pick your home airports and get emailed when a cash fare drops, with the bag limit shown on every deal.

item.title: Voicehook
item.description: Get a voice nudge when your coding agent is waiting on you, and answer by voice without watching the screen.

item.title: PhotoGenerAI
item.description: Generate and edit photos from a text prompt or an uploaded image — swap backgrounds and restyle shots in a single sentence.

item.title: Show HN: I built a tool that helps in marketing on Reddit without getting banned
item.description: Generates natural, rule-friendly Reddit replies so you can promote without getting banned.
